data_check.notes: Pack form agrees with both leans and no projection, sim median, or Pinnacle no-vig is in the pack, so this is not a sim check. Adams 221 rec yds over 2 games (110.5 per game) is well above 71.5. Harvey 18 rush plus 23 rec over 2 games (about 20.5 per game) is well below 42.5. DEN 5.41 YPC would support an LA back over, but that read was not taken because Williams 23 carries and Corum 22 carries make either rush line fail a committee pre-mortem. Stafford -0.16 EPA vs blitz and DEN's 34% blitz are the Adams kill path, not a contradiction of the 221-yard total already posted. Sutton 36 yards on 9 targets is a fluky-low efficiency and was not used as an under.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. DEN blitzed at or above 34%, Stafford's -0.16 blitz EPA became sacks and checkdowns, and Adams — possibly on the right, where DEN allows 3.86 YPA — finished near 45 yards, so 71.5 never had a path. Harvey lost on a role change the pack cannot see: injury report is MISSING, so a Dobbins or Coleman scratch is not ruled out, and his -22 air yards already mark him as the dump-off; one negative-script game of about 25 receiving yards plus 20 rush yards clears 42.5. Two-game samples, no spread, and no sim leave both leans exposed to a script the form cannot price.
slip_story: Do not force these onto one correlated slip. Adams recyds over is the LA-pass story and needs Stafford functional enough to feed the primary (survives the base and the left-side shootout flip; pressure-dependent on flip 1). Harvey rushrecyds under is a DEN role story and wins when he stays the third back behind Dobbins and Coleman, including a DEN run-lead flip. They do not need opposite scripts, but they do not win for the same reason. LA rush overs (Corum 48, Williams 53.5 or 69.5) were dropped: the 22/23 carry split and unknown spread made the counter-case as strong as the read.
